critique.observations: The as-shot and corrected images look nearly identical, so the correction was minimal. The as-shot was already close to neutral. The white sweatshirt reads neutral white, with only slightly cool shadows from blue skylight. The concrete wall and walkway read neutral gray. Skin looks natural and warm, and the foliage is a natural spring green. No meaningful cast remains. At most there is a trace of coolness in the shaded areas, which is expected under open sky. The five concrete references agree within their typical spread. A1 and A2 lean slightly magenta, A3 slightly warm and A5 slightly cool; these deviations offset one another. The sky stays blue, the clouds are white rather than cyan, and no new clipping is visible beyond what the original shows.
